title: Search Query Grammar Design
description: The unified syntax for search field combining globs, path scopes, and free text.
body: The query field's grammar unifies filter buttons and typed input into one string: bare globs, a trailing-slash directory, path:/ext:/kind: prefixes, !/- negation and a quoted phrase, mixed with plain words searched *for*, not filtered *by*. Pure by design — no React, no Monaco, no Tauri — so both a Rust-backed search source and a React hook depend on it without dragging the other's runtime along.
